'''Bein Krelwic''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] being who lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Jorra]]. He was the father of [[Tohn Krelwic]] and was employed as a factory worker. Krelwic did not approve of his son joining the [[Crimson Kreehawks]], but believed that he was still a good person at heart.<ref name="CotG" />

*''[[Chronicles of the Gatekeeper]]'' {{1st}}
